description: This file defines the `HTMLPurifier_TokenFactory` class, which provides factory methods for creating various token objects used in HTML purification. It employs cloning of prototype tokens for efficiency.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_TokenFactory
classes.description: A factory class for generating HTML token objects efficiently using prototype cloning.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes prototype tokens for start, end, empty, text, and comment token types.

methods.name: createStart
methods.description: Creates a new start token by cloning the prototype and initializing it with tag name and attributes.

methods.name: createEnd
methods.description: Creates a new end token by cloning the prototype and initializing it with tag name.

methods.name: createEmpty
methods.description: Creates a new empty (self-closing) tag token with specified name and attributes.

methods.name: createText
methods.description: Creates a new text token with provided text data.

methods.name: createComment
methods.description: Creates a new comment token with provided comment data.
